entries.effect: the set type is kept and read back; the mixer is told the type the route resolves Auto to (wired: headphones, built-in: built-in speakers, otherwise external speakers), read from the release's AudioSession route when the type is set and when the graph is first initialized. A route change after that is not followed. The mixer refusing the property is recorded as inert
